headlines.text: Rewind to 2026, when MJF vs. Mark Briscoe clashed for the AEW World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.08 ? a genuinely great match. With his knee already hanging by a thread from a title defense against Rush weeks earlier, MJF defended the AEW World Championship against Mark Briscoe in the show's opening match.

Turning the clock back to 2022: YOSHI-HASHI arrived in AEW, appearing on Rampage, rated 7.06 ? a match that delivered. Teaming with YOSHI-HASHI as Bishamon, Goto pushed the Young Bucks to the limit before the champions closed it out with the Meltzer Driver.

Turning the clock back to 2020: Hikaru Shida vs. Penelope Ford clashed for the AEW Women's World Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.98 ? a well-worked match. Penelope Ford was challenging for gold for the very first time. A hard-fought battle for the gold.

secondaries.text: Turning the clock back to 2026: the AEW TBS Title had a new owner by the end of the night as Hikaru Shida vs. Harley Cameron vs. Kris Statlander vs. Maika vs. Persephone vs. Queen Aminata battled it out in a Survival of the Fittest match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.65 ? ending the champion's reign at 1 defense. Maika was challenging for gold for the very first time. In the first-ever Survival of the Fittest match, held for the TBS Title Willow Nightingale had to vacate through injury, a furious Persephone struck a locked-in Kris Statlander with the belt out of spite ? handing the win, and the vacant championship, to Hikaru Shida.
Back on this day in 2020, it was MJF & Wardlow's first night in AEW as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.63 ? a good, competitive contest.

Rewind to 2022, when AEW welcomed Rush for the first time in a Royal Rampage match against Brody King vs. Adam Page vs. Dante Martin vs. Darby Allin vs. Dustin Rhodes vs. Frankie Kazarian vs. Keith Lee vs. Konosuke Takeshita vs. Matt Hardy vs. Max Caster vs. Penta Oscuro vs. Powerhouse Hobbs vs. Ricky Starks vs. Swerve Strickland vs. The Butcher vs. The Blade vs. Tony Nese, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.56.
